ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey to black) with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to distal tip clusters and localized surface abrasions; estimated ratio of 9:1 dark-to-light pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white contiguous clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes; scattered high-intensity linear pixels on the central and right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated shallow V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 115 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern with moderate-amplitude peaks (5-10 pixel depth) along the trailing boundary, most prominent on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge transitioning to a sharp, slightly upward taper at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters consistent with barnacle colonization located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned vertical and diagonal high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the lower central fluke and the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-contrast clusters at lobe tips indicating parasitic colonization/scarring; prominent vertical white linear scar near the median notch.
